M2 uses the slogan as the main display line and places the name high; M5 uses the invitation as its display line and places the name below the bench. Their warm plant-room subjects overlap, but the diagonal shadow organization and architectural information lanes are not a media-only swap.

relationship to M1's photo-based poster

Both use photographic plants, but M4 edits repeated care activity into an alternating sequence with a date lead, while M1 contrasts a held small pot and a domestic large plant below a serif-name header. Their spatial organization and type roles differ rather than depending on a palette substitution.
residuals: Diversity is 4, not 5: M1, M2 and M5 retain a broad left-text/right-tall-plant tendency, and supporting information across the set remains predominantly sans-serif rows. Observable changes in image editing, focal type roles, spatial boundaries and reading routes are nevertheless substantial across all five.
This is one independent craft review of the pinned selected five-member set. It does not establish the other two critics' judgments or an aggregate all-three PASS.
